### This is many hours of work. If you enjoy it, please 👍 like, 💬 comment, and feel free to ⚡ tip 😉

---

## Nodes

| Node | What it does |
|---|---|
| **LC Outpaint 🖌️➕** | Drag the canvas edges outward on the node. Drag inside the source to reposition it. **free** or locked to a common aspect ratio, grey fill. Outputs **control_image**, **control_mask** (white = new area), **mask_image**, **width**, **height**. **hold_mask**: **snap_to_image** puts the box back on the image every run and passes the image through as is (so a new image always starts clean); **held** keeps the canvas you set up and passes the image through with it. **block** set to **if_empty_mask** stops everything downstream when the mask is empty: with snap_to_image that means every run (drag the edges out, switch to held, run again), with held only if you have not pulled an edge out. Run once to get the preview. *note:* **snap_to** rounds the final size up to a multiple (8 by default), set it to 1 to turn that off. |
| **LC Create Mask 🖼️✏️** | Draw a mask right on the node. Click to add points (no limit), drag to move, shift+click removes one. Flip the toggle to **pencil** for freehand. **smooth**, **invert**, **feather**, and **opacity** are built in. Undo and Clear buttons on the node. **block** (top widget) set to **if_empty_mask** stops everything downstream until you have drawn something, same idea as Impact Pack's Preview Bridge. Run once to get the preview. |
| **LC Mask Refine ✨** | Tighten a mask with a **trimap**. **edge_erode** pulls the sure-foreground in from the mask edge, **edge_dilate** sets how far the unknown band reaches out. Only that band is decided by the **method** (**vitmatte** for hair and fine detail, **guided_filter** for speed, or **none**), so a narrower band means a tighter mask. Also **grow** (negative shrinks), **fix_gap**, **black_point** / **white_point**, **feather**, and **edge_color_spread** to cut background halos on the cutout. Plug a mask into **detail_region** (like hair) to give just that area a wider trimap (**detail_erode** / **detail_dilate**). Outputs **cutout** (RGBA), **mask**, **trimap**. Before/after wipe on the node, same as the LC123 previews: hover and the after image sits left of the pointer. **preview_view** switches between cutout, mask and trimap. Run once to get the preview. 💡 Start with 10 / 10, then shrink both toward 3 for a tight edge. **Micro adjust:** every pixel value (**grow**, **fix_gap**, **edge_erode**, **edge_dilate**, the **detail_** ones, **feather**) takes decimals in 0.1 px steps, the points step by 0.001, and the edges are true circles, not blocks. Wire sliders in as **FLOAT** (INT sockets will not plug into these). ⚠️ Numbers are real pixels. |
| **LC Remove Background ✂️** | Cut the subject out with a BiRefNet model. Outputs **cutout** (RGBA), **mask**, and **on_background** (subject on a solid color). Optional **refine** (guided_filter or vitmatte) with the same trimap controls (**edge_erode** / **edge_dilate**), plus **grow**, **black_point** / **white_point**, and **feather**. No preview on the node (add LC Mask Refine after it if you want one). Uses ComfyUI's built-in background-removal loader, so no extra dependency. 💡 Raise **black_point** to clear faint haze, use **vitmatte** for hair. |
| **LC Image Blend Advance 🎚️** | Place a layer on a background and blend it. **x_percent** / **y_percent** (0.01 steps), **scale**, **aspect_ratio**, **rotate**, **mirror**, and 29 blend modes, with **opacity** in 0.1 steps and an optional **layer_mask** (multiplied with the layer's own alpha). **background_image** is optional: leave it off and the layer goes on a transparent canvas the size of the layer (RGBA out, like LayerStyle's V3). **transform_method**: lanczos, bicubic, bilinear, nearest. Outputs **image** and **mask** (where the layer landed). Pure torch, no extra dependency. |
| **LC Segment Anything 🎯** | Select things by describing them: type **hair, eyes, bikini** and each word is found and combined. **engine**: **grounding_dino + sam** (GroundingDINO finds boxes, SAM makes masks) or **sam3** (SAM 3 does both, using ComfyUI's built-in SAM 3 support). Then the same refine as Mask Refine (**refine**, **edge_erode** / **edge_dilate**, **black_point** / **white_point**) and a before/after wipe on the node. Outputs **cutout** (RGBA), **mask**, **raw_mask**. 💡 For sam3, **sam3_threshold** 0.5 is a good start; near 0.3 it invents matches for words that are not in the image. |
| **LC Person Mask 🧍** | Pick the parts of a person: **face**, **hair**, **body**, **clothes**, **accessories**, **background**, combined into one mask. **engine**: **segformer** (higher resolution, body is arms and legs only) or **mediapipe** (body includes torso and neck skin). Then the same refine as Mask Refine. No preview on the node (add LC Mask Refine after it if you want one). Outputs **cutout** (RGBA), **mask**, **raw_mask**. 💡 For skin work, enable **face** and **body**. |
| **LC Auto Adjust 🔆** | One-click auto levels. **mode**: **RGB** (each channel on its own, also removes color casts), **lum + sat**, **luminance**, **saturation**, or **mono**. Then **red** / **green** / **blue** balance, **brightness**, **contrast**, **saturation** trims, and **strength** to blend back toward the original. All in 0.1 steps. An optional **mask** limits both where the levels are measured and where the result is applied (an alpha channel works as the mask when none is connected). Pure torch, no extra dependency. |
| **LC Depth Anything V2 🌊** | Depth map from one image, normalized 0-1 per image, **bright = near** unless **invert** is on. Reads the original Depth Anything V2 weights, so a copy you already have in `models/depthanything` works (it also finds the ones in comfyui_controlnet_aux). Outputs **depth** (3-channel image) and **depth_mask**. **resolution** in steps of 14. Matches comfyui_controlnet_aux's Depth Anything V2 (correlation 1.000). Model code is vendored, no extra package. |
| **LC Normal Map (BAE) 🗺️** | Surface normal map (RGB = XYZ) with the BAE network, the same style ControlNet's normal_bae makes. **resolution**, and **flip_y** for OpenGL vs DirectX. Matches comfyui_controlnet_aux's BAE (correlation 0.9999). Needs the `timm` package (the installer adds it if missing). 💡 Both maps are what LC Lighting Control in LC123 wants as its **depth_map** and **normal_map**. |
| **LC Face Crop 📐** | Crops to a format with the faces placed well, not a blind centre crop: one render, every social format, nobody's head cut off. **aspect_ratio** uses the same presets as LC Aspect Ratio Simplifier (or **custom**). **framing**: **widest** keeps as much picture as the format allows; **upper body**, **head & shoulders** and **face** frame tighter from the face size (character datasets). **faces**: **all** keeps every face in the crop, **largest** frames the main one (use it when posters or background people get picked up). **output_size**: **preset size** (e.g. 1080x1350) or **keep pixels**. SAM 3 finds the faces; wire a **mask** to frame anything else (a car, a product, a pet). Nothing found: a centre crop, and the console says so |
| **LC Image Rotate + Pad 🔄** | Turn, crop and pad a picture by dragging on the node. The round handle turns it (hold **Shift** for 15° steps, or type the **angle**), the frame's square handles pad (drag out) or crop (drag in), and dragging inside the frame moves the picture. The **control_mask** is white where the model has to paint: the padding and the corners a turn opens up, so it goes straight into **LC Krea2 AnyPaint**. **fit**: **expand** starts the frame around the whole turned picture, **crop** at the largest box with no empty corners. **fill**: **gray** (what Krea 2 and AnyPaint expect), **edge** (stretches the outer pixels), **white**, **black**. **aspect** locks the output shape, **snap_to** rounds the size up. Straight and quarter turns copy pixels, never resample. **block**: **until turned or framed** stops the run after this node while the picture is untouched, so the first run only puts the picture on the node; **never** always passes it on. **keep_frame**: **keep (same image)** holds the turn and frame run after run (post processing the same picture), **snap back after run** resets them once a run finishes so the next image starts clean. Run once to see the picture on the node. |
| **LC Krea2 AnyPaint 🩹** | Krea 2 inpaint and outpaint with yijunwang2's **AnyPaint LoRA** ([Here](https://huggingface.co/yijunwang2/krea2-anypaint), put it in your loras folder), run the way it was trained. Everything outside the mask comes back exactly as it was. The model sees a small copy of the whole picture while it paints, so the new part matches the light and the scene, and a thin border around the mask is redrawn so the seam disappears. **prompt**: describe the whole finished picture, not just the change. **crop_to_mask** on for inpaint (the area is redrawn in its own crop at **inpaint_resolution**), off for outpaint. **composite**: **keep original** pastes back only the painted area, **raw** is the whole redraw. Use Krea 2 Turbo, 8 steps, euler / simple, cfg 1. 💡 "Remove the car" leaves a flat blob: describe what should be there instead. |
| **LC Z-Image AnyPaint 🩹** | The same inpaint and outpaint for **Z-Image** (Turbo / Base): the same crop, keep, border and seam fix, painted by Alibaba's **Z-Image Fun ControlNet Union 2.1** in inpaint mode ([Here](https://huggingface.co/alibaba-pai/Z-Image-Turbo-Fun-Controlnet-Union-2.1), put it in models/model_patches; the 8steps one is for Turbo). The only difference from the Krea 2 node is the top two widgets: **control** (the union patch) and **control_strength**. Describe the whole finished picture in the prompt. |
| **LC SDXL AnyPaint 🩹** | The same inpaint and outpaint for any **SDXL** checkpoint (SDXL, Pony, Illustrious, your finetunes), no LoRA needed. Painted by xinsir's **ControlNet Union SDXL ProMax** in repaint mode ([Here](https://huggingface.co/xinsir/controlnet-union-sdxl-1.0), put the promax file in models/controlnet). **prompt**: describe what goes in the mask, short ("a red bucket full of fish on the pier"). To remove something, describe what should be there instead, or leave it empty and it fills from the picture around the mask (outpaint still wants the scene described). SDXL uses a real **negative** and **cfg** (25 steps, cfg 5, dpmpp_2m / karras). **fooocus_inpaint** (optional, off by default): lllyasviel's Fooocus inpaint patch ([Here](https://huggingface.co/lllyasviel/fooocus_inpaint), models/inpaint, needs Acly's **ComfyUI Inpaint Nodes**) blends best on outpaints and fills but rebuilds what was there more than it adds. ⚠️ With both on, drop **control_strength** to about 0.5: Pony and Illustrious turn to noise at 1. ⚠️ **Outpaint: control_strength about 0.2.** At 1 the straight edge of the old picture reads as a real edge, and SDXL paints a window frame, fence or line along it. Inpaint stays at 1 (the mask is surrounded by your picture, so it holds the light and edges through the hole). 💡 A boolean and two floats into **control_strength** switches it with your inpaint / outpaint toggle. |
| **LC Smart Detailer 🩹** | Replaces the SEGS / Impact FaceDetailer chain with one node. Finds what you type (**hands, face, eyes**) with SAM 3 and redraws it at full detail. Each hand or face gets its own crop, scaled to about **inpaint_resolution** squared pixels, redrawn, then blended back in. The redraw reaches a little past the pasted area and its colour is matched to the original along the seam, so the edge does not show. **tone_match** (on): the redraw gets the original's brightness, contrast and colour back where it is pasted, keeping the new detail (a light redraw otherwise comes back flat and dull); turn it off when the redraw is meant to change colours. Changing denoise, steps or feather redraws without searching again. **grow** / **feather** shape the mask, **padding** is the context around each crop, **blend** mixes the original back in (1 = all redraw). Works with 4-D and 5-D latents (SDXL, Flux, Krea 2, Anima, Qwen, etc.). Leave **negative** empty for cfg 1 models, wire it for SDXL. Nothing found? The image passes through untouched and the node says so. Before/after wipe on the node with the found areas outlined. **LC Smart Detailer (pipe) 🩹** takes the image, model, VAE and sampler settings from the LC pipe; wire an **image**, **model** or **vae** into it to use that one instead (a node without a pipe changed the picture, a model with LoRAs on it, or a different model). It puts its result back in the pipe's image and leaves two things for the nodes after it: every area the detailers redrew (merged, so face + hands + eyes add up), which **LC VOSR2 Upscale (pipe)** carries to the new size (its **protected** output), and what SAM 3 found, so the same word is never searched twice. Both are tied to the picture they were made for and ignored if it changed in between. 💡 Faces: denoise 0.3, blend 0.8. **cfg** defaults to 1 on both versions (the pipe version no longer takes the main sampler's cfg_1, which made redraws drastic). 1 works for Krea 2, Flux, Z-Image and, at detailer denoise up to about 0.4, SDXL too (tested cfg 1 to 7: the same result). It never goes below 1: below 1 the redraw comes out speckled. 💡 If your positive describes the whole scene, wire a short prompt for the area into **inpaint_positive** (e.g. "close-up of a woman's face, natural skin"). Otherwise, at denoise 0.3 and up, the scene can get drawn into every crop. |
| **LC VOSR2 Upscale 🧩** | Upscale that keeps the detailers' work. VOSR 2.0 (one step, built in, no other pack needed) sharpens and adds fine detail to the picture it is given instead of redrawing it with your model, so faces and hands come through as the detailers left them, with no new skin blotches. Run it **after** the detailers: render → **LC Smart Detailer** → **LC VOSR2 Upscale**. **upscale_by** 1.5x, 2x, 3x or 4x in one pass, 6x (3x + 2x) and 8x (4x + 2x) in two (one big pass breaks the skin up into patches), **color_alignment** wavelet keeps the colours, **tile_size** 512 (what it was trained at), **vae_tile_size** lower = less VRAM. **LC VOSR2 Upscale (pipe) 🧩** takes the picture from the LC pipe (what the detailers left in it) and puts the result back, one wire after **LC Smart Detailer (pipe)**. Its **protected** output is the detailers' areas at the new size: wire it into LC Skin Texture / LC Skin Upscale **protect_mask** so they do not add skin detail on top of the detailers' work (the plain version takes LC Smart Detailer's **mask** as **protect_mask** and gives the same output). 2x of a 1 MP picture: about 5 s and under 7 GB on an RTX 5090. Weights download on first run (about 6.5 GB). |

---

## Models and licensing

- ✋ Models are **never bundled or redistributed**. Model-backed nodes download from the original source the first time you use them, or reuse a copy you already have.
- Each model in a dropdown is labelled with its license, so you can see what you are picking.
- **VITMatte** (LC Mask Refine): `vitmatte-small-composition-1k` and `vitmatte-base-composition-1k`, both Apache-2.0. Saved under `models/vitmatte`. A copy you already have in `models/vitmatte` is picked up automatically.
- **BiRefNet** (LC Remove Background): general, matting, portrait, and HR 2048 variants, all MIT. Saved under `models/background_removal`, the same folder ComfyUI's own loader reads.
- **RMBG-2.0** (BRIA): used if you already have it in `models/RMBG/RMBG-2.0`. Not downloaded for you. ⚠️ Non-commercial license.
- Older BiRefNet `.pth` files (like `BiRefNet-ep480.pth`) use an older layout that ComfyUI cannot load, so they are not listed.
- **GroundingDINO + SAM** (LC Segment Anything): `grounding-dino-tiny` / `-base` and `sam-vit-base` / `-large` / `-huge`, all Apache-2.0, Hugging Face format. Saved under `models/grounding-dino` and `models/sam`. Your original-format `.pth` files there are not used (different layout).
- **SAM 3** (LC Segment Anything, sam3 engine): Meta's original `facebook/sam3` is gated (manual approval), so it is never downloaded for you. Your own `sam3.safetensors` in `models/sam3` (or ComfyUI's `models/detection`) is picked up. For a one-click option, the dropdown offers **SAM 3.1** (`sam3.1_multiplex_fp16.safetensors`, 1.7 GB) from `Comfy-Org/sam3.1`, the same ungated copy ComfyUI's own SAM 3 template uses, saved to `models/sam3`. SAM License terms apply (Hugging Face lists it as *other*).
- **Segformer clothes** (LC Person Mask): `mattmdjaga/segformer_b2_clothes`, saved under `models/segformer_b2_clothes`. ⚠️ Its Hugging Face card says license *other* and it is built on NVIDIA's SegFormer, so treat it as **not cleared for commercial use** until you have checked.
- **MediaPipe selfie multiclass** (LC Person Mask): Google's `selfie_multiclass_256x256.tflite`, saved under `models/mediapipe`. Check its model card for terms. The `mediapipe` Python package is not installed by this pack.

### 这是花了很多个小时做出来的。如果你喜欢，请 👍 点赞、💬 留言，也欢迎 ⚡ 打赏 😉

---

## 节点

| 节点 | 功能 |
|---|---|
| **LC Outpaint 🖌️➕** | 在节点上把画布边缘往外拖，在原图内部拖动可重新定位。**free** 或锁定为常用宽高比，灰色填充。输出 **control_image**、**control_mask**（白色 = 新增区域）、**mask_image**、**width**、**height**。**hold_mask**：**snap_to_image** 每次运行都会把框放回图像上，并原样透传图像（所以新图总是从干净状态开始）；**held** 保留你设置好的画布，并带着它透传图像。**block** 设为 **if_empty_mask** 时，遮罩为空就会停掉下游的一切：用 snap_to_image 意味着每次运行都会停（把边缘拖出去，切到 held，再运行一次），用 held 则只有在你没拉出任何边缘时才会停。先运行一次才会出预览。*注意：* **snap_to** 会把最终尺寸向上取整到某个倍数（默认 8），设为 1 即可关闭。 |
| **LC Create Mask 🖼️✏️** | 直接在节点上画遮罩。点击添加点（数量不限），拖动移动，shift+点击删除一个。把开关切到 **pencil** 就是手绘。内置 **smooth**、**invert**、**feather** 和 **opacity**。节点上有撤销和清除按钮。**block**（最上面的控件）设为 **if_empty_mask** 时，在你画出东西之前会停掉下游的一切，思路和 Impact Pack 的 Preview Bridge 一样。先运行一次才会出预览。 |
| **LC Mask Refine ✨** | 用 **trimap** 收紧遮罩。**edge_erode** 把确定的前景从遮罩边缘往里收，**edge_dilate** 决定未知带向外延伸多远。只有这条带由 **method** 来判定（**vitmatte** 适合头发和细节，**guided_filter** 追求速度，或 **none**），所以带越窄，遮罩越紧。另有 **grow**（负值为收缩）、**fix_gap**、**black_point** / **white_point**、**feather**，以及 **edge_color_spread**，用来去掉抠图上的背景光晕。把遮罩（比如头发）接到 **detail_region**，就能只给那块区域更宽的 trimap（**detail_erode** / **detail_dilate**）。输出 **cutout**（RGBA）、**mask**、**trimap**。节点上有前后对比滑动，和 LC123 的预览一样：悬停时“之后”的图像在指针左边。**preview_view** 可在 cutout、mask 和 trimap 之间切换。先运行一次才会出预览。💡 先用 10 / 10，然后把两个值都往 3 收，得到紧致的边缘。**微调：** 所有像素值（**grow**、**fix_gap**、**edge_erode**、**edge_dilate**、各个 **detail_** 项、**feather**）都支持 0.1 px 步进的小数，点的步进是 0.001，边缘是真正的圆形而不是方块。滑块要以 **FLOAT** 接入（INT 插槽接不上）。⚠️ 数值都是真实像素。 |
| **LC Remove Background ✂️** | 用 BiRefNet 模型抠出主体。输出 **cutout**（RGBA）、**mask** 和 **on_background**（纯色底上的主体）。可选 **refine**（guided_filter 或 vitmatte），trimap 控制相同（**edge_erode** / **edge_dilate**），另有 **grow**、**black_point** / **white_point** 和 **feather**。节点上没有预览（想要的话后面接一个 LC Mask Refine）。使用 ComfyUI 内置的背景移除加载器，所以没有额外依赖。💡 提高 **black_point** 可以清掉淡淡的雾边，头发用 **vitmatte**。 |
| **LC Image Blend Advance 🎚️** | 把图层放到背景上并混合。有 **x_percent** / **y_percent**（0.01 步进）、**scale**、**aspect_ratio**、**rotate**、**mirror** 和 29 种混合模式，**opacity** 以 0.1 步进，还有可选的 **layer_mask**（与图层自身的 alpha 相乘）。**background_image** 可选：不接的话，图层会放到与图层同尺寸的透明画布上（输出 RGBA，和 LayerStyle 的 V3 一样）。**transform_method**：lanczos、bicubic、bilinear、nearest。输出 **image** 和 **mask**（图层落下的位置）。纯 torch，没有额外依赖。 |
| **LC Segment Anything 🎯** | 通过描述来选取对象：输入 **hair, eyes, bikini**，每个词都会被找出来并合并。**engine**：**grounding_dino + sam**（GroundingDINO 找框，SAM 出遮罩）或 **sam3**（SAM 3 一手包办，使用 ComfyUI 内置的 SAM 3 支持）。之后是与 Mask Refine 相同的精修（**refine**、**edge_erode** / **edge_dilate**、**black_point** / **white_point**），节点上带前后对比滑动。输出 **cutout**（RGBA）、**mask**、**raw_mask**。💡 sam3 的 **sam3_threshold** 从 0.5 开始比较合适；接近 0.3 时，它会对图里根本没有的词也瞎编出匹配。 |
| **LC Person Mask 🧍** | 选取人物的各个部分：**face**、**hair**、**body**、**clothes**、**accessories**、**background**，合并成一张遮罩。**engine**：**segformer**（分辨率更高，body 只包括手臂和腿）或 **mediapipe**（body 包括躯干和脖子的皮肤）。之后是与 Mask Refine 相同的精修。节点上没有预览（想要的话后面接一个 LC Mask Refine）。输出 **cutout**（RGBA）、**mask**、**raw_mask**。💡 做皮肤处理时，同时启用 **face** 和 **body**。 |
| **LC Auto Adjust 🔆** | 一键自动色阶。**mode**：**RGB**（每个通道各自处理，同时去除色偏）、**lum + sat**、**luminance**、**saturation** 或 **mono**。之后有 **red** / **green** / **blue** 平衡、**brightness**、**contrast**、**saturation** 微调，以及用来向原图回混的 **strength**。全部 0.1 步进。可选的 **mask** 同时限制测量色阶的位置和应用结果的位置（没接遮罩时，alpha 通道会当作遮罩使用）。纯 torch，没有额外依赖。 |
| **LC Depth Anything V2 🌊** | 从单张图像生成深度图，每张图归一化到 0-1，除非开启 **invert**，否则 **越亮 = 越近**。读取原版 Depth Anything V2 权重，所以你已经放在 `models/depthanything` 里的副本可以直接用（也能找到 comfyui_controlnet_aux 里的）。输出 **depth**（3 通道图像）和 **depth_mask**。**resolution** 以 14 为步长。与 comfyui_controlnet_aux 的 Depth Anything V2 一致（相关系数 1.000）。模型代码已内置，无需额外安装包。 |
| **LC Normal Map (BAE) 🗺️** | 用 BAE 网络生成表面法线图（RGB = XYZ），风格与 ControlNet 的 normal_bae 相同。有 **resolution**，以及用于区分 OpenGL 与 DirectX 的 **flip_y**。与 comfyui_controlnet_aux 的 BAE 一致（相关系数 0.9999）。需要 `timm` 包（缺少时安装器会自动补上）。💡 这两张图正是 LC123 里 LC Lighting Control 的 **depth_map** 和 **normal_map** 所需要的。 |
| **LC Face Crop 📐** | 按指定格式裁剪，并把人脸摆在合适的位置，而不是盲目居中裁：渲一次，适配所有社交平台格式，谁的头都不会被切掉。**aspect_ratio** 使用与 LC Aspect Ratio Simplifier 相同的预设（或 **custom**）。**framing**：**widest** 在格式允许的范围内尽量多保留画面；**upper body**、**head & shoulders** 和 **face** 则根据人脸大小框得更紧（用于角色数据集）。**faces**：**all** 把每张脸都留在裁剪内，**largest** 只框主要的那张（海报或背景路人被误检时用它）。**output_size**：**preset size**（例如 1080x1350）或 **keep pixels**。由 SAM 3 找脸；接入 **mask** 可以框其他东西（汽车、产品、宠物）。什么都没找到：居中裁剪，控制台会提示 |
| **LC Image Rotate + Pad 🔄** | 在节点上拖动来旋转、裁剪和扩边。圆形手柄用来旋转（按住 **Shift** 以 15° 步进，或直接输入 **angle**），框上的方形手柄用来扩边（向外拖）或裁剪（向内拖），在框内拖动则移动图像。**control_mask** 在模型需要绘制的地方是白色：即扩边部分以及旋转后露出的四角，所以可以直接接到 **LC Krea2 AnyPaint**。**fit**：**expand** 让框一开始就包住整个旋转后的图像，**crop** 则取没有空角的最大框。**fill**：**gray**（Krea 2 和 AnyPaint 期望的）、**edge**（拉伸最外层像素）、**white**、**black**。**aspect** 锁定输出形状，**snap_to** 向上取整尺寸。直角和 90 度倍数的旋转只复制像素，不重采样。**block**：**until turned or framed** 在图像还没动过时于此节点之后停止运行，所以第一次运行只是把图放到节点上；**never** 则始终放行。**keep_frame**：**keep (same image)** 让旋转和框在多次运行间保持不变（对同一张图做后期处理），**snap back after run** 在每次运行结束后重置，让下一张图从干净状态开始。先运行一次才能在节点上看到图像。 |
| **LC Krea2 AnyPaint 🩹** | 用 yijunwang2 的 **AnyPaint LoRA** 做 Krea 2 的 inpaint 和 outpaint（[这里](https://huggingface.co/yijunwang2/krea2-anypaint)，放进你的 loras 文件夹），按训练时的方式运行。遮罩之外的一切都原样返回。模型在绘制时会看到整张图的小副本，所以新内容能匹配光线和场景，遮罩周围还有一圈细边会被重画，接缝因此消失。**prompt**：描述整张完成后的图，而不只是改动的部分。**crop_to_mask** 做 inpaint 时开启（该区域在自己的裁剪里以 **inpaint_resolution** 重画），做 outpaint 时关闭。**composite**：**keep original** 只贴回绘制的区域，**raw** 是整张重画。用 Krea 2 Turbo，8 步，euler / simple，cfg 1。💡 “Remove the car” 会留下一团平的色块：请描述那里应该出现什么。 |
| **LC Z-Image AnyPaint 🩹** | 针对 **Z-Image**（Turbo / Base）的同款 inpaint 和 outpaint：同样的裁剪、保留、边框和接缝修复，由阿里的 **Z-Image Fun ControlNet Union 2.1** 在 inpaint 模式下绘制（[这里](https://huggingface.co/alibaba-pai/Z-Image-Turbo-Fun-Controlnet-Union-2.1)，放进 models/model_patches；8steps 那个版本用于 Turbo）。与 Krea 2 节点唯一的区别是最上面两个控件：**control**（union patch）和 **control_strength**。提示词里描述整张完成后的图。 |
| **LC SDXL AnyPaint 🩹** | 适用于任何 **SDXL** checkpoint（SDXL、Pony、Illustrious、你自己的微调）的同款 inpaint 和 outpaint，不需要 LoRA。由 xinsir 的 **ControlNet Union SDXL ProMax** 在 repaint 模式下绘制（[这里](https://huggingface.co/xinsir/controlnet-union-sdxl-1.0)，把 promax 文件放进 models/controlnet）。**prompt**：描述遮罩里要出现的东西，写短一点（“a red bucket full of fish on the pier”）。要移除东西，就描述那里应该有什么，或者留空，它会根据遮罩周围的画面填充（outpaint 仍然需要描述场景）。SDXL 使用真正的 **negative** 和 **cfg**（25 步，cfg 5，dpmpp_2m / karras）。**fooocus_inpaint**（可选，默认关闭）：lllyasviel 的 Fooocus inpaint patch（[这里](https://huggingface.co/lllyasviel/fooocus_inpaint)，放 models/inpaint，需要 Acly 的 **ComfyUI Inpaint Nodes**）在 outpaint 和填充时融合得最好，但它更偏向重建原有内容，而不是添加新内容。⚠️ 两者都开时，把 **control_strength** 降到约 0.5：Pony 和 Illustrious 在 1 时会变成噪点。⚠️ **Outpaint：control_strength 约 0.2。** 到 1 时，旧图的直边会被当成真实的边缘，SDXL 就会沿着它画出窗框、栅栏或一条线。Inpaint 保持 1（遮罩被你的图像包围，所以能通过这个洞守住光线和边缘）。💡 用一个布尔值和两个浮点数接到 **control_strength**，就能跟着你的 inpaint / outpaint 开关切换。 |
| **LC Smart Detailer 🩹** | 用一个节点取代 SEGS / Impact FaceDetailer 那一整条链。用 SAM 3 找出你输入的内容（**hands, face, eyes**），并以完整细节重画。每只手或每张脸都有自己的裁剪，缩放到约 **inpaint_resolution** 的平方像素，重画后再混合回去。重画范围会稍微超出粘贴区域，并且沿接缝把颜色匹配到原图，所以边缘不会露出来。**tone_match**（开启）：重画区域在粘贴处会找回原图的亮度、对比度和颜色，同时保留新的细节（轻度重画否则会变得平淡发闷）；如果重画本来就是要改变颜色，就关掉它。改 denoise、steps 或 feather 会直接重画，不用再次搜索。**grow** / **feather** 调整遮罩形状，**padding** 是每个裁剪周围的上下文，**blend** 把原图混回来（1 = 全部用重画）。支持 4-D 和 5-D latent（SDXL、Flux、Krea 2、Anima、Qwen 等）。cfg 1 的模型把 **negative** 留空，SDXL 则要接上。什么都没找到？图像原样通过，节点会告诉你。节点上有前后对比滑动，并框出找到的区域。**LC Smart Detailer (pipe) 🩹** 从 LC pipe 取图像、模型、VAE 和采样设置；往里接 **image**、**model** 或 **vae** 就会改用你接的那个（比如没经过 pipe 的节点改过图、带了 LoRA 的模型，或者换了一个不同的模型）。它把结果放回 pipe 的图像里，并给后面的节点留下两样东西：所有细化器重画过的区域（会合并，所以脸 + 手 + 眼睛会叠加起来），由 **LC VOSR2 Upscale (pipe)** 带到新尺寸（即它的 **protected** 输出），以及 SAM 3 找到的内容，这样同一个词永远不会被搜两次。这两样都绑定在它们生成时对应的图像上，中间图像一变就会被忽略。💡 脸：denoise 0.3，blend 0.8。**cfg** 在两个版本里默认都是 1（pipe 版不再沿用主采样器的 cfg_1，那会让重画过于剧烈）。1 适用于 Krea 2、Flux、Z-Image，细化器 denoise 在约 0.4 以内时 SDXL 也适用（测过 cfg 1 到 7：结果一样）。它永远不会低于 1：低于 1 重画会出现斑点。💡 如果你的 positive 描述的是整个场景，就往 **inpaint_positive** 接一条针对该区域的短提示词（例如 “close-up of a woman's face, natural skin”）。否则在 denoise 0.3 及以上时，整个场景可能会被画进每一个裁剪里。 |
| **LC VOSR2 Upscale 🧩** | 保留细化器成果的放大。VOSR 2.0（一步完成，内置，不需要其他包）会对输入的图像做锐化并添加细节，而不是用你的模型重画，所以脸和手保持细化器处理后的样子，不会出现新的皮肤斑块。请在细化器**之后**运行：渲染 → **LC Smart Detailer** → **LC VOSR2 Upscale**。**upscale_by** 1.5x、2x、3x 或 4x 一次完成，6x（3x + 2x）和 8x（4x + 2x）分两次（一次大放大会把皮肤打碎成块），**color_alignment** wavelet 保持颜色，**tile_size** 512（训练时的尺寸），**vae_tile_size** 越低越省 VRAM。**LC VOSR2 Upscale (pipe) 🧩** 从 LC pipe 取图（即细化器留在里面的结果）并把结果放回去，紧跟在 **LC Smart Detailer (pipe)** 后面连一根线即可。它的 **protected** 输出是细化器区域在新尺寸下的版本：接到 LC Skin Texture / LC Skin Upscale 的 **protect_mask**，它们就不会在细化器的成果上再叠加皮肤细节（普通版把 LC Smart Detailer 的 **mask** 当作 **protect_mask**，效果相同）。1 MP 图像放大 2x：在 RTX 5090 上约 5 秒，占用不到 7 GB。权重首次运行时下载（约 6.5 GB）。 |

## 模型与许可

- ✋ 模型**从不打包或再分发**。依赖模型的节点会在你第一次使用时从原始来源下载，或者复用你已有的副本。
- 下拉框里的每个模型都标注了它的许可证，所以你能看到自己选的是什么。
- **VITMatte**（LC Mask Refine）：`vitmatte-small-composition-1k` 和 `vitmatte-base-composition-1k`，均为 Apache-2.0。保存在 `models/vitmatte`。你在 `models/vitmatte` 里已有的副本会被自动识别。
- **BiRefNet**（LC Remove Background）：general、matting、portrait 和 HR 2048 几个变体，均为 MIT。保存在 `models/background_removal`，也就是 ComfyUI 自带加载器读取的同一个文件夹。
- **RMBG-2.0**（BRIA）：如果你已经把它放在 `models/RMBG/RMBG-2.0` 里就会使用。不会替你下载。⚠️ 非商用许可。
- 较旧的 BiRefNet `.pth` 文件（如 `BiRefNet-ep480.pth`）使用 ComfyUI 无法加载的旧结构，所以不会列出。
- **GroundingDINO + SAM**（LC Segment Anything）：`grounding-dino-tiny` / `-base` 和 `sam-vit-base` / `-large` / `-huge`，均为 Apache-2.0，Hugging Face 格式。保存在 `models/grounding-dino` 和 `models/sam`。你放在那里的原始格式 `.pth` 文件不会被使用（结构不同）。
- **SAM 3**（LC Segment Anything，sam3 引擎）：Meta 的原版 `facebook/sam3` 是受限的（需要人工审批），所以永远不会替你下载。你自己放在 `models/sam3`（或 ComfyUI 的 `models/detection`）里的 `sam3.safetensors` 会被识别。想要一键方案的话，下拉框提供来自 `Comfy-Org/sam3.1` 的 **SAM 3.1**（`sam3.1_multiplex_fp16.safetensors`，1.7 GB），这是 ComfyUI 自己的 SAM 3 模板所用的同一份无需审批的副本，保存到 `models/sam3`。适用 SAM License 条款（Hugging Face 将其列为 *other*）。
- **Segformer clothes**（LC Person Mask）：`mattmdjaga/segformer_b2_clothes`，保存在 `models/segformer_b2_clothes`。⚠️ 它的 Hugging Face 卡片写的许可证是 *other*，且基于 NVIDIA 的 SegFormer，所以在你确认之前，请当作**未获商用许可**。
- **MediaPipe selfie multiclass**（LC Person Mask）：Google 的 `selfie_multiclass_256x256.tflite`，保存在 `models/mediapipe`。条款请查看它的模型卡。此包不会安装 `mediapipe` Python 包。
- **Depth Anything V2**（LC Depth Anything V2）：**Small 是 Apache-2.0**，**Base / Large / Giant 是 CC-BY-NC-4.0（非商用）**。保存在 `models/depthanything`。Small 排在最前面，所以它是默认值。
- **BAE normals**（LC Normal Map）：来自 lllyasviel/Annotators 的 `scannet.pt`，保存在 `models/normalbae`。⚠️ 在 ScanNet 上训练，Hugging Face 卡片只写了 *other*。在你确认之前，请当作**未获商用许可**。
- ⚠️ 有些模型是**非商用**的，标签会告诉你。商用前检查许可证是你自己的责任。

## Nodes

| Node | What it does |
|---|---|
| **LC Outpaint 🖌️➕** | Drag the canvas edges outward on the node. Drag inside the source to reposition it. **free** or locked to a common aspect ratio, grey fill. Outputs **control_image**, **control_mask** (white = new area), **mask_image**, **width**, **height**. **hold_mask**: **snap_to_image** puts the box back on the image every run and passes the image through as is (so a new image always starts clean); **held** keeps the canvas you set up and passes the image through with it. **block** set to **if_empty_mask** stops everything downstream when the mask is empty: with snap_to_image that means every run (drag the edges out, switch to held, run again), with held only if you have not pulled an edge out. Run once to get the preview. *note:* **snap_to** rounds the final size up to a multiple (8 by default), set it to 1 to turn that off. |
| **LC Create Mask 🖼️✏️** | Draw a mask right on the node. Click to add points (no limit), drag to move, shift+click removes one. Flip the toggle to **pencil** for freehand. **smooth**, **invert**, **feather**, and **opacity** are built in. Undo and Clear buttons on the node. **block** (top widget) set to **if_empty_mask** stops everything downstream until you have drawn something, same idea as Impact Pack's Preview Bridge. Run once to get the preview. |
| **LC Mask Refine ✨** | Tighten a mask with a **trimap**. **edge_erode** pulls the sure-foreground in from the mask edge, **edge_dilate** sets how far the unknown band reaches out. Only that band is decided by the **method** (**vitmatte** for hair and fine detail, **guided_filter** for speed, or **none**), so a narrower band means a tighter mask. Also **grow** (negative shrinks), **fix_gap**, **black_point** / **white_point**, **feather**, and **edge_color_spread** to cut background halos on the cutout. Plug a mask into **detail_region** (like hair) to give just that area a wider trimap (**detail_erode** / **detail_dilate**). Outputs **cutout** (RGBA), **mask**, **trimap**. Before/after wipe on the node, same as the LC123 previews: hover and the after image sits left of the pointer. **preview_view** switches between cutout, mask and trimap. Run once to get the preview. 💡 Start with 10 / 10, then shrink both toward 3 for a tight edge. **Micro adjust:** every pixel value (**grow**, **fix_gap**, **edge_erode**, **edge_dilate**, the **detail_** ones, **feather**) takes decimals in 0.1 px steps, the points step by 0.001, and the edges are true circles, not blocks. Wire sliders in as **FLOAT** (INT sockets will not plug into these). ⚠️ Numbers are real pixels. |
| **LC Remove Background ✂️** | Cut the subject out with a BiRefNet model. Outputs **cutout** (RGBA), **mask**, and **on_background** (subject on a solid color). Optional **refine** (guided_filter or vitmatte) with the same trimap controls (**edge_erode** / **edge_dilate**), plus **grow**, **black_point** / **white_point**, and **feather**. No preview on the node (add LC Mask Refine after it if you want one). Uses ComfyUI's built-in background-removal loader, so no extra dependency. 💡 Raise **black_point** to clear faint haze, use **vitmatte** for hair. |
| **LC Image Blend Advance 🎚️** | Place a layer on a background and blend it. **x_percent** / **y_percent** (0.01 steps), **scale**, **aspect_ratio**, **rotate**, **mirror**, and 29 blend modes, with **opacity** in 0.1 steps and an optional **layer_mask** (multiplied with the layer's own alpha). **background_image** is optional: leave it off and the layer goes on a transparent canvas the size of the layer (RGBA out, like LayerStyle's V3). **transform_method**: lanczos, bicubic, bilinear, nearest. Outputs **image** and **mask** (where the layer landed). Pure torch, no extra dependency. |
| **LC Segment Anything 🎯** | Select things by describing them: type **hair, eyes, bikini** and each word is found and combined. **engine**: **grounding_dino + sam** (GroundingDINO finds boxes, SAM makes masks) or **sam3** (SAM 3 does both, using ComfyUI's built-in SAM 3 support). Then the same refine as Mask Refine (**refine**, **edge_erode** / **edge_dilate**, **black_point** / **white_point**) and a before/after wipe on the node. Outputs **cutout** (RGBA), **mask**, **raw_mask**. 💡 For sam3, **sam3_threshold** 0.5 is a good start; near 0.3 it invents matches for words that are not in the image. |
| **LC Person Mask 🧍** | Pick the parts of a person: **face**, **hair**, **body**, **clothes**, **accessories**, **background**, combined into one mask. **engine**: **segformer** (higher resolution, body is arms and legs only) or **mediapipe** (body includes torso and neck skin). Then the same refine as Mask Refine. No preview on the node (add LC Mask Refine after it if you want one). Outputs **cutout** (RGBA), **mask**, **raw_mask**. 💡 For skin work, enable **face** and **body**. |
| **LC Auto Adjust 🔆** | One-click auto levels. **mode**: **RGB** (each channel on its own, also removes color casts), **lum + sat**, **luminance**, **saturation**, or **mono**. Then **red** / **green** / **blue** balance, **brightness**, **contrast**, **saturation** trims, and **strength** to blend back toward the original. All in 0.1 steps. An optional **mask** limits both where the levels are measured and where the result is applied (an alpha channel works as the mask when none is connected). Pure torch, no extra dependency. |
| **LC Depth Anything V2 🌊** | Depth map from one image, normalized 0-1 per image, **bright = near** unless **invert** is on. Reads the original Depth Anything V2 weights, so a copy you already have in `models/depthanything` works (it also finds the ones in comfyui_controlnet_aux). Outputs **depth** (3-channel image) and **depth_mask**. **resolution** in steps of 14. Matches comfyui_controlnet_aux's Depth Anything V2 (correlation 1.000). Model code is vendored, no extra package. |
| **LC Normal Map (BAE) 🗺️** | Surface normal map (RGB = XYZ) with the BAE network, the same style ControlNet's normal_bae makes. **resolution**, and **flip_y** for OpenGL vs DirectX. Matches comfyui_controlnet_aux's BAE (correlation 0.9999). Needs the `timm` package (the installer adds it if missing). 💡 Both maps are what LC Lighting Control in LC123 wants as its **depth_map** and **normal_map**. |
| **LC Face Crop 📐** | Crops to a format with the faces placed well, not a blind centre crop: one render, every social format, nobody's head cut off. **aspect_ratio** uses the same presets as LC Aspect Ratio Simplifier (or **custom**). **framing**: **widest** keeps as much picture as the format allows; **upper body**, **head & shoulders** and **face** frame tighter from the face size (character datasets). **faces**: **all** keeps every face in the crop, **largest** frames the main one (use it when posters or background people get picked up). **output_size**: **preset size** (e.g. 1080x1350) or **keep pixels**. SAM 3 finds the faces; wire a **mask** to frame anything else (a car, a product, a pet). Nothing found: a centre crop, and the console says so |
| **LC Image Rotate + Pad 🔄** | Turn, crop and pad a picture by dragging on the node. | **LC Vision Caption 📝** | Generates text from a loaded LC Vision model, an instruction, up to three reference images and a reference video. |
| **LC Vision Loader 🔬** | Loads a Qwen-VL GGUF model and its vision projector. keep_model_loaded off unloads it after the Vision nodes are done, so the image model gets the whole card. |
| **LC Vision Moviemaker 🎥** | Plans a video as several continuous segments in one call, each written as a self-contained MiniMax H3 prompt. |
| **LC Vision Prompt Enhancer 📝** | Rewrites a prompt through an LC Vision model using a preset instruction (text only). |

---

## LC ModelBuilder v0.4.0

[github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC_ModelBuilder_nodes](https://github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC_ModelBuilder_nodes)

| Node | What it does |
|---|---|
| **LC Checkpoint Save** | Saves an all-in-one checkpoint (model, clip, vae) with an enabled toggle to skip the save. |
| **LC Diffusion Model Save** | Saves just the diffusion model, with no clip or vae. |
| **LC Face Variety Scorer 🧑‍🤝‍🧑** | Scores how alike the faces in a batch are with ArcFace (0 to 1, lower = more variety), plus a crowd score for group shots. |
| **LC Krea2 Block Merge Advanced** | Merges Krea2 checkpoints with a draggable per-block ratio curve across the 28 blocks plus sliders for the named regions. |
| **LC Krea2 LoRA Block Scan** | 🧪 BETA, still in testing. Finds where a LoRA locks the face or changes the whole image by turning off one block group at a time, and suggests a block curve for the Editor. |
| **LC Krea2 LoRA Editor** | 🧪 BETA, still in testing. Loads a Krea 2 LoRA with each of the 28 blocks turned up or down, attention and MLP scaled separately, and spikes softened. |
| **LC Krea2 LoRA Merge** | 🧪 BETA, still in testing. Merges two to four Krea 2 LoRAs with a per-block A / B curve (sum or TIES). |
| **LC Krea2 Semantic Vector Tuner** | Amplifies or attenuates specific regions of a single Krea2 checkpoint's weights (not a merge). |
| **LC LoRA Extract** | Turns a finetune into a LoRA (finetuned minus its base): all layers, blocks only or a custom block list. Unchanged layers are left out. |
| **LC LoRA Save** | 🧪 BETA, still in testing. Saves an edited or merged LoRA as a standard file with every edit baked in, optionally at a new rank, with enabled and embed_workflow switches. |
| **LC Model Merge (any precision)** | Merges two models stored in different precisions (bf16 with fp8, int8, nvfp4 or GGUF, in either order). The result stays full precision. |
| **LC Scoreboard 🏆** | Head-to-head counter for A / B tests: #1 Win, Tie and #2 Win buttons, with the leader and percentages shown on the node. |

---

nodes.title: LC Settings ⚙️

en.text:
# LC Settings ⚙️

**Where are they?** Open **Settings** (the gear), then **LC Settings ⚙️**. There are five sections: **Align**, **Connections**, **Notes**, **Optimization** and **Performance**, plus **Vision** when **LC Vision** is installed.

- 💡 Missing a setting? Restart ComfyUI, then press **Ctrl+F5** so the browser loads the new files.

---

### 📐 Align

**Align tool**
- Default: **On**
- The switch for the whole tool. Off = no **Align** button (the LC logo) in the top toolbar and none of the features below.
- With it on, the **Align** button turns Align on or off **for the open workflow**: light gray with the red flame = on, dark gray with a gray flame = off.
    - That on/off is saved in the workflow. Save it with Align on and it opens with Align on, even on a fresh ComfyUI.
    - Every workflow tab keeps its own. Switch tabs and the tool follows that tab (on in one, off in the other, no mix-ups).
    - Turning it on or off counts as a change to the workflow, so you get the unsaved dot.
- Nodes snap to **Node lines**, groups snap to **Group lines**. A line lights up when you get close.
- Works on the classic canvas and in **Nodes 2.0**.
- **Snap distance** is ComfyUI's own **Snap to grid size** (Settings > Lite Graph > Canvas). Smaller grid = tighter snap. New lines land on that grid too.
    - **Shift** while dragging hands the drag to ComfyUI's own grid snap (no line snap). With **Always snap to grid** on, a line snap still wins on the axis it caught.

**Rulers**
- Default: **On**
- Rulers on the top and left edge while Align is on:
    - **Left click** a ruler: adds a **Node line** (blue). Nodes snap to it.
    - **Right click** a ruler: adds a **Group line** (orange). Groups snap to it.
    - **LC Notes** snap to both, since a note can label a node or a group.
    - Click a line's marker again to remove it. Drag a marker to move it.
- Lines save with the workflow.

**Line reveal distance (px)**
- Default: **120**
- Lines stay invisible until the cursor or whatever you drag gets this close.

**Also snap to other nodes and groups**
- Default: **Off**
- On = also snap to other nodes' edges and centers (no line is shown for those).

---

### 🔌 Connections

**Connection FX**
- Default: **Off**
- While you drag a wire, every socket it can plug into glows in its socket color.
- Get close and rings pulse out of the socket. Closer = bigger and brighter.
- **Connection FX reach (px):** how close the cursor has to be before the rings start. Default 160.
- **Connection FX zoomed-out glow (%):** zoomed out, every valid socket glows brighter so you can find it. Default 60.
- Classic canvas only. With **Nodes 2.0** on it stays out of the way.

---

### 🔬 Vision

- Only there when **LC Vision** is installed.

**Vision Assistant**
- Default: **On**
- The sidebar helper: checkup, chat, guided tours and snapshots. Off removes the tab.

**Batch snapshot**
- Default: **On**
- A look at the run before it starts. A single image always goes straight through.
- Run only stops to ask when it looks like a mistake: more than 16 images, several runs on a fixed seed, a big upscale on many images.

**Vision Assistant chat model**
- Default: **Auto** (leave it here). It picks the biggest model that fits your card and only loads it while you chat.
- It unloads a minute after the last answer, or the moment you hit Run.
- **Off** = no chat model at all. The checkup, snapshots and saved tours still work, with no VRAM.

**Default n_ctx for new LC Vision Loaders**
- Default: **8192**, the best pick for most people. Smaller saves memory. Saved workflows keep their own value.

**Vision models**
- What's on your drive, and a **Download** button for the models made for LC Vision.

---

### 📝 Notes

**Requires LC Vision for translation**
- Shows whether **LC Vision** is installed. Translating notes needs it.

**Note language**
- LC notes will open in the default language set for Comfy if they have already been translated to that

**Translate all notes**
- One click translates every **LC Note** in the open workflow (subgraphs too) into your **Note language**, one after another, then shows them in it.
- Notes already written in that language, or with an up-to-date translation, are skipped. Out-of-date translations (⚠️) are redone.
- Only LC Notes are touched. Other notes are left alone.
- Needs **LC Vision** installed (nothing to wire).
- ⚠️ Save the workflow afterwards to keep the translations.

**Link cards**
- Default: **On**
- A line with just `@[card](https://…)` in an LC Note shows the page as a card: picture, site, title and description. `@[card: caption](https://…)` adds your own caption.
- Put each card on a line of its own, with a blank line before and after it. Without the blank lines they stay plain links.
- Double-click the note to edit: the cards step aside so you can change the `@[card](…)` text. They come back when you click away.
- Wide pictures (banners) get a wider slot so they show whole.
- ComfyUI reads each card's page once, and the picture loads from that site. Only public web addresses, never your own machine or network. Off = cards show as plain links.

---

### 🩺 Optimization

**Fast cancel**
- Default: **On**
- Cancel stops a run in a fraction of a second instead of finishing the step first (heavy models, USDU, video).
- Works with every sampler, nothing to wire.

**Free text encoder before sampling**
- Default: **On**
- When sampling starts, any big text encoder (1 GB or more) still in VRAM moves to RAM, so the model gets the whole card.
- Biggest win on H3 and Krea 2. A new prompt reloads it from RAM in a second or two.

**Comfy Optimization Report**
- One button. It pans the canvas by itself for a few seconds, times what every pack in the open workflow draws and runs, and scans their files.
- You get a list of what slows your canvas down, biggest first, sorted into:
    - **That pack's own settings** (the exact setting name, where it lives and its current value)
    - **LC123 optimization settings**
    - **ComfyUI settings**
    - **Sidebar tabs**
    - **Required to function** (no setting, it is how that pack works)
- Only node packs used in the open workflow are analyzed.
- Every setting it suggests is checked against its current value:
    - ⚠️ big gain · ✅ worthwhile gain · 💡 small gain
    - ⚪ already set · ➖ does not apply · ℹ️ required, no setting for it
- **Show last run:** the button at the top flips to the previous report. Each new run also shows what got faster and which fixes are done since last time.
    - Only the last run is kept (it survives a refresh). Each run replaces it.
- Nothing is changed. (Keep the mouse still while it runs.)
- 💡 Also in the right-click menu on the empty canvas.

**System & Model Optimization Report**
- One button. It tests this machine in about 10 seconds: graphics card, VRAM, RAM, page file, drive speed, and which speed-ups really work here (Sage, Triton, Sol-Attn, Comfy Kitchen, fp8 / int8 / nvfp4, llama-cpp).
- ⚠️ problem · 💡 worth changing · ✅ works · ℹ️ info · ➖ not installed
- Then it tells you which model files suit this machine:
    - **Recommended to install:** links to Sage, Triton, Comfy Kitchen etc. for this card when they're missing (links only, nothing is installed)
    - **LC Vision model suggestion** (Quality / Optimal / Fast, with the context size to set)
    - **When picking a model (includes custom models):** what to get for Quality, Optimal and Fast, a size guide, and what to avoid
    - **Model recommendations:** exact files with download links for the tested base models, plus **All base models at a glance**
- **Show last run** and **Copy report** work like the Comfy Optimization Report. It will not run while ComfyUI is generating.
- Nothing is changed. (Also in the right-click menu on the empty canvas.)
- 💡 The **LC Model Optimizer** nodes read this report: run it once and they load the right files and speed-ups for this machine. (With LC Vision installed, its Loader also puts a ★ on the model that suits your card.)

**Node Pack Usage Report**
- One button: **Scan my workflows folder**. It reads every saved workflow (subgraphs too) and shows which installed packs they actually use.
- Lists the packs no workflow uses, the ones only one or two use, and nodes your workflows need that no installed pack has.
- Nothing is changed or uninstalled.

---

### ⚡ Performance

These only change what you see on the canvas. Generation, VRAM, **Save Image** and every **IMAGE** output stay full resolution. (A lighter preview never means a lighter image.)

| Setting | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| **Remove wipe** | Off | Turns off the hover A/B wipe on LC image FX nodes. The last result still shows. |
| **Half-resolution previews** | Off | Draws FX previews at half size. Less work while panning. |
| **Clamp longest side** | Off | Shrinks on-node previews so the longest side fits **Max edge**. |
| **Max edge (px)** | 768 | Only used when **Clamp longest side** is on. Range 256 to 2048. Try 512 on heavy graphs. |
| **No preview when collapsed** | On | Collapsed FX nodes skip drawing their preview. |
| **Hide FX on-node previews** | Off | Hides every LC image FX preview. |
| **Recent colors** | On | Keeps your last 8 custom colors in the right-click **Colors** menu. Adds a Custom picker if Custom Scripts is not installed. |
| **Skin Beauty full preview override** | On | **LC Skin Beauty** keeps a full-quality preview even with half-res or clamp on, so you can still zoom into skin. Wipe still follows **Remove wipe**. |
| **LoRA loader info button** | On | Shows the ℹ button on each **LC LoRA Loader** row. Trigger words come from the LoRA file itself (no internet). Turn off to declutter. |
| **Preview distance (px)** | 40 | Like node text, an on-node image switches off when you zoom out far enough that it is drawn smaller than this. Smaller previews switch off first. 0 = always draw. |

**Never affected:** **LC Image Compare 🔎**, **LC Image Split 🖼️** and **LC Dynamic Overlay** keep their full preview and wipe no matter what (only **Preview distance** switches them off when zoomed far out).

**Suggested setups**
- **Normal use:** leave everything at default.
- **Laggy graph:** turn on **Half-resolution previews** and **Clamp longest side** (Max edge 512). Keep **No preview when collapsed** on.
- **Lightest canvas:** turn on **Hide FX on-node previews**. Use **Image Compare** or **Image Split** when you need to see a before/after.
- 💡 Changes apply on the next redraw. Pan the canvas a little, no restart needed.

---

"True Nothing is. Permitted Everything is"- Yoda Auditore, Assassin's Wars

zh.text:
# LC 设置 ⚙️

**在哪里？** 打开 **Settings**（齿轮），然后进入 **LC Settings ⚙️**。一共有五个部分：**Align**、**Connections**、**Notes**、**Optimization** 和 **Performance**，安装了 **LC Vision** 时还有 **Vision**。

- 💡 找不到某个设置？重启 ComfyUI，然后按 **Ctrl+F5**，让浏览器加载新文件。

---

### 📐 Align

**Align tool**
- 默认：**开**
- 整个工具的总开关。关 = 顶部工具栏里没有 **Align** 按钮（LC 标志），下面的功能也都没有。
- 开启后，**Align** 按钮可以**针对当前打开的工作流**开关 Align：浅灰色带红色火焰 = 开，深灰色带灰色火焰 = 关。
    - 这个开/关状态会保存在工作流里。开着 Align 保存，下次打开就是开着的，即使是全新的 ComfyUI。
    - 每个工作流标签页各自保存。切换标签页，工具会跟随那个标签页（一个开一个关，不会混淆）。
    - 开关它算作对工作流的修改，所以会出现未保存的圆点。
- 节点吸附到 **Node lines**，分组吸附到 **Group lines**。靠近时线会亮起来。
- 在经典画布和 **Nodes 2.0** 中都能用。
- **Snap distance** 就是 ComfyUI 自己的 **Snap to grid size**（Settings > Lite Graph > Canvas）。网格越小，吸附越紧。新的线也会落在这个网格上。
    - 拖动时按住 **Shift**，会把拖动交给 ComfyUI 自己的网格吸附（不做线吸附）。开启 **Always snap to grid** 时，线吸附仍然会在它捕获的那个轴上优先生效。

**Rulers**
- 默认：**开**
- Align 开启时，顶部和左侧边缘会出现标尺：
    - **左键点击**标尺：添加一条 **Node line**（蓝色）。节点会吸附到它。
    - **右键点击**标尺：添加一条 **Group line**（橙色）。分组会吸附到它。
    - **LC Notes** 两种都吸附，因为一个笔记可以标注节点，也可以标注分组。
    - 再次点击线的标记可以删除。拖动标记可以移动。
- 线会随工作流一起保存。

**Line reveal distance (px)**
- 默认：**120**
- 线一直是隐形的，直到光标或你拖动的东西靠近到这个距离。

**Also snap to other nodes and groups**
- 默认：**关**
- 开 = 同时吸附到其他节点的边缘和中心（这些不会显示线）。

---

### 🔌 Connections

**Connection FX**
- 默认：**关**
- 拖动连线时，所有可以接入的接口都会以各自接口的颜色发光。
- 靠近时，接口会向外扩散光圈。越近 = 越大越亮。
- **Connection FX reach (px)：** 光标要多近，光圈才开始出现。默认 160。
- **Connection FX zoomed-out glow (%)：** 缩小视图时，每个有效接口会发出更亮的光，方便你找到它。默认 60。
- 仅限经典画布。开启 **Nodes 2.0** 时，它会自动让开。

---

### 🔬 Vision

- 只有安装了 **LC Vision** 才会出现。

**Vision Assistant**
- 默认：**开**
- 侧边栏助手：检查、聊天、引导教程和快照。关闭会移除这个标签页。

**Batch snapshot**
- 默认：**开**
- 在运行开始前先看一眼。单张图像始终直接通过。
- 只有看起来像是失误时才会停下来询问：超过 16 张图、固定 seed 下多次运行、对很多图做大幅放大。

**Vision Assistant chat model**
- 默认：**Auto**（保持这个就行）。它会选出你显卡能装下的最大模型，并且只在你聊天时才加载。
- 最后一次回答一分钟后，或者你一点 Run 的瞬间，它就会卸载。
- **Off** = 完全没有聊天模型。检查、快照和已保存的教程仍然可用，且不占显存。

**Default n_ctx for new LC Vision Loaders**
- 默认：**8192**，对大多数人来说是最佳选择。更小可以省内存。已保存的工作流会保留它们自己的值。

**Vision models**
- 显示你硬盘上有什么，以及一个 **Download** 按钮，用来下载为 LC Vision 准备的模型。

---

### 📝 Notes

**Requires LC Vision for translation**
- 显示是否已安装 **LC Vision**。翻译笔记需要它。

**Note language**
- 如果 LC notes 已经被翻译成 Comfy 默认设置的语言，就会以该语言打开

**Translate all notes**
- 一次点击，就会依次把当前工作流（包括子图）里每一个 **LC Note** 翻译成你的 **Note language**，然后以该语言显示。
- 已经是该语言写的笔记，或翻译是最新的笔记会被跳过。过期的翻译（⚠️）会重做。
- 只处理 LC Notes。其他笔记不动。
- 需要安装 **LC Vision**（不用连线）。
- ⚠️ 之后记得保存工作流，才能保留翻译。

**Link cards**
- 默认：**开**
- LC Note 中只有 `@[card](https://…)` 的一行，会把该页面显示为卡片：图片、网站、标题和描述。`@[card: caption](https://…)` 可以加上你自己的说明文字。
- 每张卡片单独占一行，前后各留一个空行。没有空行的话，它们只是普通链接。
- 双击笔记进行编辑：卡片会让开，这样你就能修改 `@[card](…)` 文本。点击别处后它们又会回来。
- 宽图（横幅）会得到更宽的位置，以便完整显示。
- ComfyUI 对每张卡片的页面只读取一次，图片从该网站加载。只支持公开的网址，绝不包括你自己的机器或网络。关 = 卡片显示为普通链接。

---

### 🩺 Optimization

**Fast cancel**
- 默认：**开**
- 取消会在不到一秒内停止运行，而不是先把当前这一步跑完（重型模型、USDU、视频）。
- 对所有采样器都有效，不用连线。

**Free text encoder before sampling**
- 默认：**开**
- 采样开始时，仍留在显存里的任何大型文本编码器（1 GB 或以上）都会移到内存里，这样模型就能独占整张显卡。
- 对 H3 和 Krea 2 收益最大。新的提示词会在一两秒内从内存重新加载它。

**Comfy Optimization Report**
- 一个按钮。它会自己平移画布几秒钟，测量当前工作流中每个插件包的绘制和运行耗时，并扫描它们的文件。
- 你会得到一份拖慢画布的清单，最严重的排在前面，分为：
    - **该插件包自己的设置**（确切的设置名称、它在哪里、当前值）
    - **LC123 优化设置**
    - **ComfyUI 设置**
    - **侧边栏标签页**
    - **功能所必需**（没有设置，它本来就是这样工作的）
- 只分析当前工作流中用到的节点包。
- 它建议的每一个设置都会对照当前值检查：
    - ⚠️ 收益大 · ✅ 值得的收益 · 💡 收益小
    - ⚪ 已设置 · ➖ 不适用 · ℹ️ 必需，没有对应设置
- **Show last run：** 顶部的按钮会切换到上一份报告。每次新的运行还会显示相比上次变快了什么、哪些修复已经完成。
    - 只保留最近一次（刷新后依然保留）。每次运行都会替换它。
- 不会更改任何东西。（运行期间请保持鼠标不动。）
- 💡 在空白画布上右键菜单里也有。

**System & Model Optimization Report**
- 一个按钮。大约 10 秒钟测试这台机器：显卡、显存、内存、页面文件、硬盘速度，以及哪些加速项在这里真正有效（Sage、Triton、Sol-Attn、Comfy Kitchen、fp8 / int8 / nvfp4、llama-cpp）。
- ⚠️ 问题 · 💡 值得改 · ✅ 可用 · ℹ️ 信息 · ➖ 未安装
- 然后它会告诉你哪些模型文件适合这台机器：
    - **Recommended to install：** 如果缺少，会给出适合这块显卡的 Sage、Triton、Comfy Kitchen 等的链接（只有链接，不会安装任何东西）
    - **LC Vision model suggestion**（Quality / Optimal / Fast，以及要设置的 context size）
    - **When picking a model（包括自定义模型）：** Quality、Optimal 和 Fast 各应该选什么、大小指南，以及要避免什么
    - **Model recommendations：** 测试过的基础模型的确切文件和下载链接，外加 **All base models at a glance**
- **Show last run** 和 **Copy report** 的用法和 Comfy Optimization Report 一样。ComfyUI 正在生成时它不会运行。
- 不会更改任何东西。（空白画布上右键菜单里也有。）
- 💡 **LC Model Optimizer** 节点会读取这份报告：运行一次，它们就会为这台机器加载合适的文件和加速项。（如果安装了 LC Vision，它的 Loader 还会在适合你显卡的模型上打一个 ★。）

**Node Pack Usage Report**
- 一个按钮：**Scan my workflows folder**。它会读取每个已保存的工作流（包括子图），并显示它们实际用到了哪些已安装的插件包。
- 列出没有任何工作流用到的插件包、只有一两个工作流用到的插件包，以及你的工作流需要但没有任何已安装插件包提供的节点。
- 不会更改或卸载任何东西。

---

### ⚡ Performance

这些只会改变你在画布上看到的东西。生成、显存、**Save Image** 以及每个 **IMAGE** 输出都保持完整分辨率。（预览变轻不代表图像变轻。）

| 设置 | 默认 | 作用 |
|---|---|---|
| **Remove wipe** | 关 | 关闭 LC 图像 FX 节点上悬停的 A/B 擦除对比。最后一次结果仍然会显示。 |
| **Half-resolution previews** | 关 | 以一半尺寸绘制 FX 预览。平移时负担更小。 |
| **Clamp longest side** | 关 | 缩小节点上的预览，使最长边适应 **Max edge**。 |
| **Max edge (px)** | 768 | 仅在 **Clamp longest side** 开启时使用。范围 256 到 2048。重型工作流可以试试 512。 |

# LC Settings ⚙️

**Where are they?** Open **Settings** (the gear), then **LC Settings ⚙️**. There are five sections: **Align**, **Connections**, **Notes**, **Optimization** and **Performance**, plus **Vision** when **LC Vision** is installed.

- 💡 Missing a setting? Restart ComfyUI, then press **Ctrl+F5** so the browser loads the new files.

---

### 📐 Align

**Align tool**
- Default: **On**
- The switch for the whole tool. Off = no **Align** button (the LC logo) in the top toolbar and none of the features below.
- With it on, the **Align** button turns Align on or off **for the open workflow**: light gray with the red flame = on, dark gray with a gray flame = off.
    - That on/off is saved in the workflow. Save it with Align on and it opens with Align on, even on a fresh ComfyUI.
    - Every workflow tab keeps its own. Switch tabs and the tool follows that tab (on in one, off in the other, no mix-ups).
    - Turning it on or off counts as a change to the workflow, so you get the unsaved dot.
- Nodes snap to **Node lines**, groups snap to **Group lines**. A line lights up when you get close.
- Works on the classic canvas and in **Nodes 2.0**.
- **Snap distance** is ComfyUI's own **Snap to grid size** (Settings > Lite Graph > Canvas). Smaller grid = tighter snap. New lines land on that grid too.
    - **Shift** while dragging hands the drag to ComfyUI's own grid snap (no line snap). With **Always snap to grid** on, a line snap still wins on the axis it caught.

**Rulers**
- Default: **On**
- Rulers on the top and left edge while Align is on:
    - **Left click** a ruler: adds a **Node line** (blue). Nodes snap to it.
    - **Right click** a ruler: adds a **Group line** (orange). Groups snap to it.
    - **LC Notes** snap to both, since a note can label a node or a group.
    - Click a line's marker again to remove it. Drag a marker to move it.
- Lines save with the workflow.

**Line reveal distance (px)**
- Default: **120**
- Lines stay invisible until the cursor or whatever you drag gets this close.

**Also snap to other nodes and groups**
- Default: **Off**
- On = also snap to other nodes' edges and centers (no line is shown for those).

---

### 🔌 Connections

**Connection FX**
- Default: **Off**
- While you drag a wire, every socket it can plug into glows in its socket color.
- Get close and rings pulse out of the socket. Closer = bigger and brighter.
- **Connection FX reach (px):** how close the cursor has to be before the rings start. Default 160.
- **Connection FX zoomed-out glow (%):** zoomed out, every valid socket glows brighter so you can find it. Default 60.
- Classic canvas only. With **Nodes 2.0** on it stays out of the way.

---

### 🔬 Vision

- Only there when **LC Vision** is installed.

**Vision Assistant**
- Default: **On**
- The sidebar helper: checkup, chat, guided tours and snapshots. Off removes the tab.

**Batch snapshot**
- Default: **On**
- A look at the run before it starts. A single image always goes straight through.
- Run only stops to ask when it looks like a mistake: more than 16 images, several runs on a fixed seed, a big upscale on many images.

**Vision Assistant chat model**
- Default: **Auto** (leave it here). It picks the biggest model that fits your card and only loads it while you chat.
- It unloads a minute after the last answer, or the moment you hit Run.
- **Off** = no chat model at all. The checkup, snapshots and saved tours still work, with no VRAM.

**Default n_ctx for new LC Vision Loaders**
- Default: **8192**, the best pick for most people. Smaller saves memory. Saved workflows keep their own value.

**Vision models**
- What's on your drive, and a **Download** button for the models made for LC Vision.

---

### 📝 Notes

**Requires LC Vision for translation**
- Shows whether **LC Vision** is installed. Translating notes needs it.

**Note language**
- LC notes will open in the default language set for Comfy if they have already been translated to that

**Translate all notes**
- One click translates every **LC Note** in the open workflow (subgraphs too) into your **Note language**, one after another, then shows them in it.
- Notes already written in that language, or with an up-to-date translation, are skipped. Out-of-date translations (⚠️) are redone.
- Only LC Notes are touched. Other notes are left alone.
- Needs **LC Vision** installed (nothing to wire).
- ⚠️ Save the workflow afterwards to keep the translations.

**Link cards**
- Default: **On**
- A line with just `@[card](https://…)` in an LC Note shows the page as a card: picture, site, title and description. `@[card: caption](https://…)` adds your own caption.
- Put each card on a line of its own, with a blank line before and after it. Without the blank lines they stay plain links.
- Double-click the note to edit: the cards step aside so you can change the `@[card](…)` text. They come back when you click away.
- Wide pictures (banners) get a wider slot so they show whole.
- ComfyUI reads each card's page once, and the picture loads from that site. Only public web addresses, never your own machine or network. Off = cards show as plain links.

---

### 🩺 Optimization

**Fast cancel**
- Default: **On**
- Cancel stops a run in a fraction of a second instead of finishing the step first (heavy models, USDU, video).
- Works with every sampler, nothing to wire.

**Free text encoder before sampling**
- Default: **On**
- When sampling starts, any big text encoder (1 GB or more) still in VRAM moves to RAM, so the model gets the whole card.
- Biggest win on H3 and Krea 2. A new prompt reloads it from RAM in a second or two.

**Comfy Optimization Report**
- One button. It pans the canvas by itself for a few seconds, times what every pack in the open workflow draws and runs, and scans their files.
- You get a list of what slows your canvas down, biggest first, sorted into:
    - **That pack's own settings** (the exact setting name, where it lives and its current value)
    - **LC123 optimization settings**
    - **ComfyUI settings**
    - **Sidebar tabs**
    - **Required to function** (no setting, it is how that pack works)
- Only node packs used in the open workflow are analyzed.
- Every setting it suggests is checked against its current value:
    - ⚠️ big gain · ✅ worthwhile gain · 💡 small gain
    - ⚪ already set · ➖ does not apply · ℹ️ required, no setting for it
- **Show last run:** the button at the top flips to the previous report. Each new run also shows what got faster and which fixes are done since last time.
    - Only the last run is kept (it survives a refresh). Each run replaces it.
- Nothing is changed. (Keep the mouse still while it runs.)
- 💡 Also in the right-click menu on the empty canvas.

**System & Model Optimization Report**
- One button. It tests this machine in about 10 seconds: graphics card, VRAM, RAM, page file, drive speed, and which speed-ups really work here (Sage, Triton, Sol-Attn, Comfy Kitchen, fp8 / int8 / nvfp4, llama-cpp).
- ⚠️ problem · 💡 worth changing · ✅ works · ℹ️ info · ➖ not installed
- Then it tells you which model files suit this machine:
    - **Recommended to install:** links to Sage, Triton, Comfy Kitchen etc. for this card when they're missing (links only, nothing is installed)
    - **LC Vision model suggestion** (Quality / Optimal / Fast, with the context size to set)
    - **When picking a model (includes custom models):** what to get for Quality, Optimal and Fast, a size guide, and what to avoid
    - **Model recommendations:** exact files with download links for the tested base models, plus **All base models at a glance**
- **Show last run** and **Copy report** work like the Comfy Optimization Report. It will not run while ComfyUI is generating.
- Nothing is changed. (Also in the right-click menu on the empty canvas.)
- 💡 The **LC Model Optimizer** nodes read this report: run it once and they load the right files and speed-ups for this machine. (With LC Vision installed, its Loader also puts a ★ on the model that suits your card.)

**Node Pack Usage Report**
- One button: **Scan my workflows folder**. It reads every saved workflow (subgraphs too) and shows which installed packs they actually use.
- Lists the packs no workflow uses, the ones only one or two use, and nodes your workflows need that no installed pack has.
- Nothing is changed or uninstalled.

---

### ⚡ Performance

These only change what you see on the canvas. Generation, VRAM, **Save Image** and every **IMAGE** output stay full resolution. (A lighter preview never means a lighter image.)

| Setting | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| **Remove wipe** | Off | Turns off the hover A/B wipe on LC image FX nodes. The last result still shows. |
| **Half-resolution previews** | Off | Draws FX previews at half size. Less work while panning. |
| **Clamp longest side** | Off | Shrinks on-node previews so the longest side fits **Max edge**. |
| **Max edge (px)** | 768 | Only used when **Clamp longest side** is on. Range 256 to 2048. Try 512 on heavy graphs. |
| **No preview when collapsed** | On | Collapsed FX nodes skip drawing their preview. |
| **Hide FX on-node previews** | Off | Hides every LC image FX preview. |
| **Recent colors** | On | Keeps your last 8 custom colors in the right-click **Colors** menu. Adds a Custom picker if Custom Scripts is not installed. |
| **Skin Beauty full preview override** | On | **LC Skin Beauty** keeps a full-quality preview even with half-res or clamp on, so you can still zoom into skin. Wipe still follows **Remove wipe**. |
| **LoRA loader info button** | On | Shows the ℹ button on each **LC LoRA Loader** row. Trigger words come from the LoRA file itself (no internet). Turn off to declutter. |
| **Preview distance (px)** | 40 | Like node text, an on-node image switches off when you zoom out far enough that it is drawn smaller than this. Smaller previews switch off first. 0 = always draw. |

**Never affected:** **LC Image Compare 🔎**, **LC Image Split 🖼️** and **LC Dynamic Overlay** keep their full preview and wipe no matter what (only **Preview distance** switches them off when zoomed far out).

**Suggested setups**
- **Normal use:** leave everything at default.
- **Laggy graph:** turn on **Half-resolution previews** and **Clamp longest side** (Max edge 512). Keep **No preview when collapsed** on.
- **Lightest canvas:** turn on **Hide FX on-node previews**. Use **Image Compare** or **Image Split** when you need to see a before/after.
- 💡 Changes apply on the next redraw. Pan the canvas a little, no restart needed.

---

"True Nothing is. Permitted Everything is"- Yoda Auditore, Assassin's Wars

nodes.title: LC VOSR2 Upscale🧩

en.text:
## LC VOSR2 Upscale🧩

**What is it?**

- An upscaler built for *speed* and low VRAM, with the highest quality possible.

- It uses a dedicated upscale model (VOSR 2.0) that sharpens and adds fine detail without redrawing the picture.

- 💡Hook it up after my detailers with the pipe version. It passes along what the detailers already fixed, so LC Skin Upscale and LC Skin Texture don't turn skin pores into freckles or craters.
---

### Speed and size chart*

| upscale_by | Output size | Time | GPU memory |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1.5x | 1596 x 2028 | 2.8 s | 4.7 GB |
| 2x | 2128 x 2704 | 4.4 s | 4.8 GB |
| 3x | 3192 x 4056 | 8.6 s | 5.1 GB |
| 4x | 4256 x 5408 | 16 s | 5.7 GB |
| 6x (3x + 2x) | 6384 x 8112 | 46 s | 8.4 GB |
| 8x (4x + 2x) | 8512 x 10816 | 75 s | 12.0 GB |

**All tests based on a 1064x1352 render on an RTX 5090, warm.*

**⏱️ Time will vary by card, but the output size will not. About 5 GB covers 1.5x - 3x, so it can almost run on a 🥔**

---

**Settings ⚙️**

- **tile_size:** 512, what it was trained at. Leave it.
- **vae_tile_size:** lower = less VRAM, a little slower.
- **seed:** only changes the finest grain.
- **protected:** the detailers' areas at the new size. Wire it into **protect_mask** on LC Skin Upscale and LC Skin Texture so they do not add skin detail twice.
- 👋🏼 **The first run downloads the weights (about 6.5 GB) into `models/vosr2`.** This takes a few minutes.

nodes.title: **LC Smart Detailer 🩹**

en.text:
**LC Smart Detailer 🩹**
- Finds the face with SAM 3, redraws it at full detail, and blends it back in.
- Runs **before** the upscale, on the small picture, where it is fast and sees the whole face.
- **prompt:** "Face". Add **:1** (`Face:1`) for only the biggest face.
- **threshold:** 0.5. Lower finds more (and more wrong things).
- **grow:** 4 - 8. **feather:** 8 - 12.
- **padding:** 64 - 128. More = the model sees more of the scene around the face.
- **inpaint_resolution:** 1024.
- **denoise:** 0.3 - 0.35. Higher starts adding blotches and freckles, then redraws a different face.
- **blend:** 1. Want a lighter touch? Lower the denoise, not the blend.
- **cfg:** 1. **tone_match:** on.
- **inpaint_positive:** leave it empty, the main prompt is used.
- ⚠️ Do not use "detailed realistic skin". In Krea 2 that means "Hey! Make giant pores and blotches!!"
